title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the Apps edit permission could execute arbitrary…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability that allows users with the Apps edit permission role to execute arbitrary code as the Splunk SOAR service account by installing a malicious app. This occurs because the platform does not restrict app dependencies to validated binary packages before installation.
